meta.source: kubernetes/k8s.io, first-parent changes on main from 2026-05-12 to 2026-11-12 (head 2b3d9153) that touch Terraform, Kubernetes YAML, Helm values, Grafana, Prometheus rules or a Dockerfile
meta.checks: chant audit over the tree; per-file chant import and chant lint; chant helm localize on values files with a saved chart
meta.labelling: merge-blocking findings by hand, one by one, with the reason on each; every other finding by rule, from a reason that holds for every finding of that rule here, as the reasons table says

reasons.elekto: a new Deployment without a hardened security context; hardening is a policy and nothing about the service is broken by its absence
reasons.graf-copied: the duplicate panel id or overlap is in the JSON of upstream Prow dashboards copied in whole; Grafana renumbers a duplicate id and moves an overlapping panel when it loads the dashboard, and no later change in the window touched them
reasons.rule-ARGO003: the cluster is registered in kubernetes/gke-utility/argocd/clusters.yaml; a per-file run cannot see it
reasons.rule-ARGO005: the source.path exists in the audited tree
reasons.rule-COR001: judges the TypeScript chant import wrote, not the change
reasons.rule-COR004: judges the TypeScript chant import wrote, not the change
reasons.rule-COR009: judges the TypeScript chant import wrote, not the change
reasons.rule-EVL001: a tool error: the import wrote an expression it then rejects
reasons.rule-GRAF101: an imported dashboard declares no datasource variable, which Grafana does not need
reasons.rule-GRAF107: a key the pinned Grafana schema lacks and Grafana still accepts
reasons.rule-PROM217: a recording rule naming convention; the repository uses prow:pod and prow:job on purpose
reasons.rule-SEC010: the high-entropy string is a URL, ARN, managed policy name, digest or secret path, not a credential
reasons.rule-TF009: access_key is an HMAC key id fed from secret_data, which the provider already marks sensitive
reasons.rule-TF010: a variable type constraint is a style choice; nothing breaks without it
reasons.rule-TF011: a variable description is documentation style
reasons.rule-TF012: an output description is documentation style
reasons.rule-TF017: depends_on on a module works; the rule states a design preference
reasons.rule-TF020: an unreferenced declaration is cleanup, not a defect
reasons.rule-TF039: a pessimistic version range is a deliberate pinning policy here
reasons.rule-WK8001: a namespace written in a manifest is normal
reasons.rule-WK8102: labels are an organisational convention; no object in this repository needs them to work
reasons.rule-WK8201: resource limits are a policy; the repository sets requests on purpose
reasons.rule-WK8301: probes are a policy for a small internal service
reasons.rule-WK8302: a single replica is a sizing choice
reasons.rule-WK8503: the Secret is made by an ExternalSecret in another file of the same kustomization
